summary: Phase 3H Reports close-out: read-only API spot checks (tests/spot_phase3h_api.py, run as a script, NOT pytest) + Playwright UI on preview as admin@kkt.in. Numbers all tie: Collections identity 'Bank-wise ₹14,64,18,177 + Cash ₹5,83,40,827 = Collections ₹20,47,59,004' identical on Bank-wise, no remainder line, Cheques in hand ₹40,000 (1 cheque) on both; Feb-2026 period shows Refunds paid out −₹4,22,892 on Collections. Bank-wise columns Bank/Mode/Receipts/Cleared/Reversed/Received. Bills vs Collection default line '= Customer status bills raised' ₹38,01,69,795 matches Customer status; Include cancelled adds '· cancelled' tower rows + 'Cancelled bookings ₹23,28,400'. Outstanding group-by has Project/Tower/Floor/Flat/Booking(+Customer/Sales), floor→flat grouping renders; As of 31 Oct = ₹3,54,60,791 (78) = Customer status As of 31 Oct; in-hand ₹3,43,288 (2 cheques); API as_of=2099-01-01 → 422 'As of can't be after today'. Outstanding PDF = A4 landscape (841.9×595.3pt), money cells single-line. Booking register lines '80 live' / '2 cancelled' present. Stacking plan: no CUST-/customer_id in API or UI. Cash vs account other-income line ₹4,95,868; Cancellations column 'Deduction kept (other income)'. System Health 'All 5 uniqueness rules applied'. 390px Night/Day: no horizontal overflow on Collections/Outstanding, lines wrap cleanly. MAIN FAILURE: every report-line drill link (in-hand, booking-register live/cancelled, refunds, other-income) is broken or loses its filter.

critical.issue: Links are '/reports/booking-register?booking_status=…'. booking-register is not in the frontend LEGACY_REDIRECT, so the click opens the OLD Reports page with 'No data for these filters' instead of the register filtered to that status. The API itself filters fine (/api/reports/v3/booking-register?booking_status=Cancelled → 2, Active,Completed → 80). Fix: link to '/reports/v3/booking-register?booking_status=…'.

The link '/reports/cheques?status=In+hand' goes through legacyTarget() in pages/Reports.jsx:1698, which only carries from_date/to_date/project_id. 'status' is dropped, so the user lands on /reports/v3/cheques with all 144 cheques and STATE=All. /reports/v3/cheques?status=In+hand works directly (1 cheque). Fix: link straight to '/reports/v3/cheques?status=In+hand', or have legacyTarget pass through unknown params.

minor.issue: Link '/reports/cancellations' isn't in LEGACY_REDIRECT, so it opens the old Reports page (title 'reports.'). Even at /reports/v3/cancellations the default period is This FY, which shows 0 cancellations because both cancellations (27 Jan / 03 Mar 2026) are in FY25-26. The link should carry period_from/period_to (all-time, or the source report's period) so the ₹4,95,868 can be traced.

minor.endpoint: in-hand line for a past As of / past period
minor.issue: Outstanding As of 31 Oct shows 'Cheques in hand ₹3,43,288 (2 cheques)' and Collections Feb-2026 shows ₹7,35,000 (4 cheques), but the link opens today's in-hand list (1 cheque ₹40,000). The drill doesn't match the number it was tapped from.

Outstanding 'waived ₹31,250' vs Customer status 'waived ₹25,000' today. Totals still agree (₹4,48,61,305), so the difference is probably other-charge waivers, but the two Waived figures are not labelled the same way. Owner may question it.

ui_bugs.issue: booking-register live/cancelled and refunds/other-income lines open the legacy Reports page, and in-hand loses its status filter (see backend_issues). Clicking them gives the user a page that is wrong or empty.

Future days are disabled in the calendar (max=today), so picking one does nothing. The toast 'As of can't be after today' never appears from the picker. The last valid date is kept, so the date is still refused, but the review spec expected a toast. Opening ?as_of=2099-01-01 directly gives a full-page 'Couldn't load this report — As of can't be after today' with a Retry button that can't help. It does not keep the last valid date or fall back to today.

Not tested: point 5 (payment against a fully-paid manual bill), because preview has 0 manual bills and money writes are disallowed. Retest by clicking report-line-in-hand (expect 1 cheque, STATE In hand), report-line-cancelled/live on booking-register (expect 2/80 rows in the v3 sheet), and report-line-other-income on cash-vs-account (expect the 2 cancellations). Backend pytest suite was deliberately not run.
rca of the issue: Report-line links point at /reports/<key>. The route /reports/:key renders Reports.jsx, which redirects only keys in LEGACY_REDIRECT (lib/reportsV3.js) and rebuilds the query string from from_date/to_date/project_id only. So cheques loses ?status, and booking-register/cancellations (not whitelisted) render the old ReportView with no data. Repro: /reports/v3/booking-register → click '2 cancelled' → URL /reports/booking-register?booking_status=Cancelled → old page 'No data for these filters'. Mitigation: emit /reports/v3/... links from the backend.
